prompt_text: One 16:9 cinematic image containing a clean 3x3 semantic storyboard grid for the CHECKOUT teaser. Each panel shows one beat: security monitors quad, concierge at desk, hurricane lobby, elevator indicator, ocean in elevator shaft, duplicated reflection, sprinting guests, title moment, CHECKOUT typography. Premium supernatural thriller, sodium emergency lighting, drowned-teal shadows, wet marble, anamorphic mood.
notes: Higgsfield CLI nano_banana_2 grid from approved CHECKOUT concept.

prompt_text:
Create a 12-second cinematic teaser for "CHECKOUT," a supernatural prestige thriller — hurricane luxury hotel, sodium emergency lighting, drowned-teal shadows, chrome rain on glass. Pacing: brutal 0.3–0.5s cuts tightening to 0.2s flash-frames at the drop. Needle-drop: low sub-bass pulse, distant generator thrum, one dead-silence beat before title.

[0:00–0:03 — Monitors]
Handheld whip through empty marble lobby, four security monitors flicker — the same pale woman in lobby, pool, corridor, rooftop at once. Hard cut: young concierge breath fogging the glass, reflection wrong by half a beat.

[0:03–0:07 — Evacuation]
Rapid-fire: guests in wet couture sprinting, PA distortion, palm fronds hammering windows. Flash-frames: room key, wristband, elevator indicator, ocean on a floor map that should read 12.

[0:07–0:11 — Flood]
Power snap. Every elevator door slides open to roaring black water instead of a floor. Concierge stares into the shaft — her face duplicated on a monitor behind her, smiling.

[0:11–0:12 — Title]
Vacuum silence. Whisper: "you're still checked in." CHECKOUT slams in chrome serif. Subsonic hit. Black.

Style: Anamorphic 2.39:1, halation on practicals, crushed blacks, magenta-cyan split-tone, Alexa grain. Faces lit from below. No logos. Blackout on final hit.
notes: Higgsfield CLI seedance_2_0 from approved timestamp-sizzler prompt.
